NONE: › to speak quickly in a way that cannot be understood, usually when you are very frightened or confused
（通常因為害怕或頭腦不清而）急促不清地說，語無倫次地說

example: Stop gibbering, man, and tell us what you saw.
別這麼語無倫次的，老兄，告訴我們你看到甚麼吧。

NONE: › spoken or written words that have no meaning
莫名其妙的話（或文字）；文理不通的話（或文字）；胡扯

example: I was so nervous, I just started talking gibberish.
我太緊張了，開始語無倫次起來。

長臂猿
